question: Can paired-content cancellation supervise a compact edit latent that predicts a safer and more transferable explicit operator from an after-reference alone?

primary_method_basis.paper: InstantRetouch: Personalized Image Retouching without Test-time Fine-tuning Using an Asymmetric Auto-Encoder
primary_method_basis.used_idea_only: paired before/after features supervise a content-disentangled retouching latent; no paper code, weights, model architecture, dataset or thresholds are used
primary_method_basis.clean_room_difference: the learned output is only the existing bounded 12-parameter explicit colour operator, never final RGB

latent.teacher: winner descriptor minus same-scene original descriptor

operator.target_resize: winner ICC-normalized sRGB resized to exact original geometry with Pillow Lanczos

stop_rules: All calibration candidate, direct, permuted and global parameters freeze before any calibration original is read.
The paired-latent oracle is computed only after prediction freeze and is diagnostic, never an input to the candidate.
Any calibration gate failure closes before sealed original or render acquisition.
No descriptor grid, PCA rank, ridge, bounds, dose, role, threshold, reference exclusion or gate rescue is allowed on this cohort.
A pass opens only a separately frozen sealed confirmation and does not promote product behavior.
claim_ceiling: Private internal-research paired-supervised after-reference to bounded explicit-operator identification D0; not population preference, film, stock, scanner, arbitrary-source, package, capability or product evidence.
